A1.justification: Both complete 35-page PDFs describe the same ATLAS research and include Appendices A–I. Full text and rendered-page comparisons establish identical paper content, with differences confined to the page-1 arXiv stamp.

before.justification: Section 4 reports original NAS benchmarking, proxy correlations and search-time results on Frappe, Diabetes and Criteo. Appendices D–G contain additional empirical evaluations.

after.justification: The same original experiments remain in Section 4 and Appendices D–G, including the proxy correlations in Table 1 and anytime-search results in Figure 6.

M1.justification: ATLAS retains identical ExpressFlow filtering, regularized evolution, successive-halving refinement and budget-aware coordination in Section 3 and Appendix G.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Frappe, Diabetes and Criteo, plus the same four image benchmarks in Table 15: NB101-CF10, NB201-CF10, NB201-CF100 and NB201-IM. No dataset, task or test scenario changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches in every experiment, including RS/RE/RL/BOHB, RE-NAS and TabNAS, the zero-cost proxies, Warmup and Move-Proposal variants, and weight sharing.

E3.justification: The AUC and SRCC metrics, search spaces, training settings in Table 3, architecture sampling procedures and time-budget experiments are identical throughout both versions.

E4.justification: Appendix D retains the same positivity, initialization, batch-size, data-agnosticism and recalibration analyses. Appendix E's coordinator, sensitivity and noise studies are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Figure 4 still reports medians across 100 runs, and Appendix D.1 still specifies five repeats and median correlations for the batch-size study. Uncertainty displays and reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results match, including appendix results. For example, Table 1 retains ExpressFlow SRCCs of 0.82, 0.73 and 0.90 on Frappe, Diabetes and Criteo, and Table 11 retains ATLAS's 62-second search cost.

T1.justification: Mathematical definitions, assumptions, Equations 1–13 and the derivations in Appendix G.3–G.4 are identical.

C1.justification: The contributions concerning NAS-Bench-Tabular, ExpressFlow and anytime NAS through ATLAS are unchanged. The abstract and introduction retain the claim of up to 82.75x faster search.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the same mechanism explanations, tradeoffs and qualifications, including Section 4.2's observation that higher proxy scores need not yield higher AUC. No interpretation or limitation changes.

D1.justification: Hyperparameters in Appendix C, hardware disclosures in Appendices D–E, pseudocode in Appendix G.2 and code/data access instructions in Appendix I are identical.

R1.justification: The reference list and Appendix A literature review are identical, including the positioning relative to existing tabular NAS and training-free evaluation methods.

P1.justification: Only the page-1 arXiv stamp text changes from v1 dated 15 Mar 2024 to v2 dated 6 May 2024. Titles, authors, prose, terminology and document structure remain identical.

P2.justification: The updated page-1 margin stamp has a slight placement adjustment. Figures 1–18, Tables 1–16, captions and all body layouts are identical.

improvement.justification: The research narrative, empirical evidence, theory and reproducibility information are identical, including the appendices. Updating and slightly repositioning the arXiv version/date stamp does not meaningfully affect paper quality.
